entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A plane ruled by a pantheon of gods, filled with monsters, where mortals endure and thrive in walled city-states.

entities.name: The Gods of Theros
entities.description: An awe-inspiring pantheon whose petty whims and wrath mortals fear.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: The polis of learning, progress, magic and devotion to the gods, hemmed in by golden wheat fields and the Siren Sea.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: The polis where martial prowess is held in highest esteem, centered on a cliff-top fortress.

entities.name: Setessa
entities.description: The isolated, fiercely independent polis surrounded by concentric rings of forest, whose people venerate nature.

events.summary: Mortals endure and thrive on Theros behind the walls of great poleis, each a bulwark against raging monsters.
events.quote: each city-state a bulwark against the raging monsters that roam the more savage places of Theros.

relations.quote: Meletis, the polis of learning, progress, magic, and devotion to the gods
